propertySets.name: Pset_WaterStratumCommon
propertySets.definition: Properties expressing the composition and any variability in the height of the body of water. Ranges are non-negative describing a spread.

properties.name: SeicheRange
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range between peaks and troughts of seiche (resonant) waves.

properties.name: TidalRange
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range between high and low tide levels.

properties.name: WaveRange
properties.definition: Indicative (95%-100%) range between peaks and troughs of waves
